programs.title: Mr White Mr Black
programs.desc: Before dying, Gopi's father asks him to find Kishen and hand over a piece of land. Gopi travels to Goa, where he is drawn into chaos by Kishen and his dangerous look-alike brother, the hoodlum Hari.

programs.title: Anjaana Anjaaani
programs.desc: The film of two strangers, who meet on a bridge intending to commit suicide. After bonding over their shared miseries,they make a pact to live life to the fullest for the next 20 days and explore various adventures together. As they embark on this trip, they begin to develop feelings for each other, leading to a complex and emotional journey. Will they embrace their new-found love or stick to their original plan?

programs.title: Kuch Toh Hai
programs.desc: The movie follows the story of a young couple who move into a new house, only to discover that it is haunted by a mysterious presence. As they try to unravel the truth behind the entity, they uncover a dark secret that threatens their very existence.
